title: Data Graphs and Fractions Unit Test
subject: math
unitTitle: Pie charts, line graphs and fractions

items.prompt: In a survey of 24 children, 13 chose soccer and 8 chose badminton. How many more chose soccer than badminton? Show your working.

points.text: Reads the two bar heights as 13 and 8
Subtracts to get 13 - 8 = 5 more chose soccer

items.prompt: Explain why two line graphs showing the same rise from 20 to 40 can look different in steepness.

points.text: States that slope depends on the axis scale
Concludes that graph A runs 0 to 50 while graph B runs 0 to 200, so the same rise of +20 looks flatter on graph B

items.prompt: A baker uses 3/4 kg of flour in the morning and 1/4 kg in the afternoon. How much flour is used in total?

levels.label: Secure
levels.descriptor: Working is complete, ordered and uses correct data graph and fraction notation throughout.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Working is partial or notation is inconsistent, but the method can be followed.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Little or no working shown; the method cannot be followed.
